# Data notes (auto-generated by build_macro_panel.py on 2026-10-14)

## Timing rules
* Prediction date for month t = the 15th of month t (close to the Michigan preliminary release).
* Unemployment for month t-1 is released on the first Friday of month t; PCE prices for month t-2 at the end of month t-1; GDP advance estimate about four weeks after quarter end. The real-time panel uses ALFRED vintages dated the 15th of each month, so delays (e.g., the 2025 and 2026 shutdowns) and revisions are reflected automatically.
* Quarterly GDP is never interpolated to months: the model uses the latest published quarterly growth rate as of the prediction date.
